Casey: Quick share — I put together a tiny 2-slide micro-template pack for sprint goals + peer feedback. Dropping a short, copy-paste friendly snippet. link: https://drive.redwood/g/snap-goal-pack :eyes:

Jamie: Love it. Can you paste the ultra-compact 3-line variant so managers can copy quickly?

Casey: Yep — heres the 3
line manager-friendly template (keeps self-reviews super short):
```
Goal (1 line): <what success looks like>
Outcome (1 line): <metric or customer impact>
Evidence (1
2 bullets max): - Bullet 1
- Bullet 2
Ask (opt, 1 line): <what you need from manager/peers>
Risk (opt, 1 line): <blocker/risk>
```

Ari: The Risk row is gold — helps 1:1 focus. Could we also add a 1-sentence peer feedback micro-prompt?

Casey: Added. Peer micro-prompt (one line to paste into peer messages):
"Observed impact: <short outcome>. Example: <specific example>. Suggestion: <one concrete next step>."

Lauren: Will use for calibration notes. Can we make a tiny variant for promotion-ready evidence (one-liner + link)?

Casey: Sure, new promo-ready micro-evidence line: "Promo Evidence: <one-sentence impact + link to artifact>". Kept it optional.

Michael: Minor wording: swap "Why it matters" -> "Outcome" across all slides (clearer).

Casey: Done. I also exported a plain-text paste and a PDF that fits in a single Slack message.

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/micro-goal-pack-v1.pdf (perm: org) :white_check_mark:

Jamie: Thanks! Ill try this in my 1:1s tomorrow and report back with any tweaks.

Casey: Appreciate it. If folks want competency tags or calibration snippets added, reply here and Ill append a 2-line addon slide. :thumbsup:
